projects.title: Humane (AI Text Humanizer)
projects.tagline: Humane is a specialized web application built with React and Vercel, engineered to bypass strict enterprise AI detectors by...
projects.description: Utilized Grok API and advanced prompt engineering techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Meta-Cognition, Dual Persona Adversarial) to transform AI-generated text by injecting high perplexity and burstiness, bypassing AI detection. Integrated three contextual transformation modes to vary output tone, alongside a secure admin data workbench featuring human-in-the-loop rating, a diff viewer, and AI detection scoring for future dataset curation.

projects.title: TeNo
projects.tagline: Website version of the TeNo side-panel extension for links, reminders, cart items, and timers.
projects.description: Developed a keyboard-first productivity command center operating as both a standalone web application and a browser extension. Designed a terminal-inspired, multi-tab interface for seamlessly managing saved links, e-commerce carts, and daily reminders with real-time cloud synchronization. Engineered advanced functionalities including rapid keyboard-shortcut navigation, secure user authentication, and a robust background timer that reliably triggers desktop notifications.
features: Dual Theme System - Learn about the Minimalist vs Modern styling architecture.

Core Modules - Understand the primary functional tabs: Links, Cart, Reminders, Timer, and Prompts.
Settings & Compliance - Details on data export (GDPR/DPDP) and server-side account deletion.
